items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 29 July 2026 11:49am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 29 July 2026 at 11:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure north of Scotland will push a weakening frontal system across the Irish Sea later today.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, veering this evening and at first tonight to between West and North 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the southeast of area. Becoming West or Northwest 3 or 4 in all waters later tonight, increasing West 4 occasionally 5 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then patchy rain for a time later today.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 4 occasionally 5, decreasing West or Northwest 3 or 4.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
